crossRefs.note: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also…
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
David said, “Yahweh who delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…

translations.web: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
translations.bsb: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
translations.kjv: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
translations.asv: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
